sql.value: SELECT * FROM ( ( SELECT '收入' AS fundType, oi.id AS id, oi.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_no AS orderNo, oi.order_staff_name AS orderStaffName, oii.account_type_name AS accountTypeName, oii.amount AS income, null AS expense, oii.remarks AS remarks, oii.source_doc_no AS sourceDocNo, oii.source_business_name AS sourceBusinessName, oii.source_date AS sourceDate FROM jxc_other_income oi JOIN jxc_other_income_item oii ON oi.id = oii.other_income_id WHERE oi.order_status = '已审核' AND (:merchantId IS NULL OR oi.merchant_id = :merchantId) AND (:accountBookId IS NULL OR oi.account_book_id = :accountBookId) AND (:orderStaffName IS NULL OR oi.order_staff_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :orderStaffName, '%')) AND (:startTime IS NULL OR oi.order_date >= :startTime) AND (:endTime IS NULL OR oi.order_date <= :endTime) ) UNION ALL ( SELECT '支出' AS fundType, oe.id AS id, oe.order_date AS orderDate, oe.order_no AS orderNo, oe.order_staff_name AS orderStaffName, oei.account_type_name AS accountTypeName, null AS income, oei.amount AS expense, oei.remarks AS remarks, oei.source_doc_no AS sourceDocNo, oei.source_business_name AS sourceBusinessName, oei.source_date AS sourceDate FROM jxc_other_expense oe JOIN jxc_other_expense_item oei ON oe.id = oei.other_expense_id WHERE oe.order_status = '已审核' AND (:merchantId IS NULL OR oe.merchant_id = :merchantId) AND (:accountBookId IS NULL OR oe.account_book_id = :accountBookId) AND (:orderStaffName IS NULL OR oe.order_staff_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :orderStaffName, '%')) AND (:startTime IS NULL OR oe.order_date >= :startTime) AND (:endTime IS NULL OR oe.order_date <= :endTime) ) ) tmp_table ORDER BY orderDate DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ( SELECT 1 FROM jxc_other_income oi JOIN jxc_other_income_item oii ON oi.id = oii.other_income_id WHERE oi.order_status = '已审核' AND (:merchantId IS NULL OR oi.merchant_id = :merchantId) AND (:accountBookId IS NULL OR oi.account_book_id = :accountBookId) AND (:orderStaffName IS NULL OR oi.order_staff_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :orderStaffName, '%')) AND (:startTime IS NULL OR oi.order_date >= :startTime) AND (:endTime IS NULL OR oi.order_date <= :endTime) ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 1 FROM jxc_other_expense oe JOIN jxc_other_expense_item oei ON oe.id = oei.other_expense_id WHERE oe.order_status = '已审核' AND (:merchantId IS NULL OR oe.merchant_id = :merchantId) AND (:accountBookId IS NULL OR oe.account_book_id = :accountBookId) AND (:orderStaffName IS NULL OR oe.order_staff_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :orderStaffName, '%')) AND (:startTime IS NULL OR oe.order_date >= :startTime) AND (:endTime IS NULL OR oe.order_date <= :endTime) ) ) tmp_count
